title: LZMA2PipelineBenchmarkContract
description: Schema definition for LZMA2 performance benchmark and regression verification telemetry

dataset_name.description: Name of test corpus dataset (e.g. silesia, enwik8, synthetic_sparse)

throughput_mb_per_sec.description: Measured compression or decompression throughput in MB/s

checksum_sha256.description: Decompressed output SHA-256 hash for golden oracle verification

zero_regression_passed.description: True if performance strictly meets or exceeds historical peak threshold
